```

LiHua: Thanks for the suggestions! I'll definitely check them out. Appreciate it!
```

```
WolfgangSchulz: Sounds like a plan! Let’s do it. It’ll be great to have a workout buddy. I’ll see you there!
LiHua: Awesome! Looking forward to it! Can’t wait to see your progress. Can’t wait for our next session! 💪😄
```
